name: NeetoCal
description:
NeetoCal is scheduling software for booking meetings. This connector lets Claude work with your NeetoCal workspace in plain language.

Ask Claude to look up open slots before you commit to a time, book a client into a meeting, reschedule or cancel a booking, or approve one that is waiting on you. It can create scheduling links and one-off links, build reusable meeting templates, set up availability schedules with weekly hours and date-specific overrides, manage team members and session packages, and record payments and discount codes.

Because the details usually live in the conversation already, an email, a pasted note or a thread turns into the booking without you retyping anything.

Connect over OAuth and the connector acts as you: it sees what you can see, and it can only create, update or delete if you granted those permissions when you approved the connection.

_published_faq.name: How do I add NeetoCal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add NeetoCal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://connect.neetocal.com/mcp/messages. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the NeetoCal MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: NeetoCal lists 48 MCP tools, including CreateAutomationRule, CreateAvailability, CreateBooking, CreateBookingPayment, CreateDiscountCode, CreateMeeting, CreateMeetingAvailability, CreateMeetingDuration, CreateMeetingOneOffLink, CreateMeetingSpot, CreateMeetingTemplate, and CreateTeamMember.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to NeetoCal?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to NeetoCal in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
NeetoCal requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
NeetoCal is developed by Neeto. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
